methodology.fixture: Independent cold copies of stopped P2C B1 PostgreSQL/OpenSearch,11032 works, same readonly packs
methodology.pacing: Matched nominal20docs/s; actual ACK and internal index rates determine matching; max variants no pacing,11032 queued. No concurrent build or benchmark.
methodology.pit: One fresh PIT/request, closed after reading first page; closure outside API timer. No concurrent probe PIT accumulation.
methodology.same_application: API dist bind-mounted on palimora-p2d-api base image; same compiled application in each OFF/ON comparison. Image hash identifies base only.
methodology.build_difference: Final build additionally maps top-level HTTP400 to original SEARCH_QUERY_INVALID; successful search path unchanged. Both variants always use the same build within each comparison.
methodology.resources: Docker/Node1Hz; OS boundaries and2s snapshots. CPU/counters deltas, gauges sampled. took nested in client duration; subqueries overlap.
methodology.composition: Per-request gap from search JSON body completion to document SQL start: includes validation, merge, dispatch, scheduling. Not an isolated instruction-level merge timer.
methodology.bytes: Request UTF8 body bytes and reserialized decoded response JSON bytes, not wire/compressed bytes.

limits: Single full-throughput pair; host/cache/GC/merge variance prevents attributing all throughput difference to msearch.
Matched ACK rates differ4.8percent, within10percent; inspect internal index rates too.
Raw JSON hashes differ with object key order; structural comparison independently validates hits/facets/cursors including array order.
No independent percentile subtraction; full no-facet ablation savings are not the msearch benefit.
Operational ingest control has no continuous search traffic: it verifies integration/throughput, not maximum search contention.
Short windows and sampled thread pools can miss transient queue peaks; byte accounting instrumentation overhead not separately re-benchmarked.

adoption.reason: Stable idle improvement, no repeatable matched API P95 gain; full-throughput API P95 worsens144.65to156.37ms and observed ACK rate92.8to85.6docs/s. Reject default adoption.
adoption.residual: Search tail latency under indexing remains unresolved; no further phase implemented.

functional.fault_injection: Per-subquery error, timeout flag, shard failure, missing aggregations and transport failure injected around real responses; real fielddata failure and expired PIT also exercised.
functional.early_probe_failures: Corrected Nest exception code assertion and empty freeform fixture assumption; early roots excluded from benchmarks.

projection.counter_limit: Container shutdown reset the CPU counter; use projection_process event CPU instead. Raw negative delta retained only in private source summary.

validation.production_scope: catalog-search.ts and explicit Compose flag only; projection, canonical, parser, mappings, frontend unchanged
